alex: quick check — customer custx-prod-eu1 (private VPC) seeing remote_write backoff + lots of prom cache evictions in their dashboard. Where are the authoritative places to look for: (1) prom remote_write queue/backoff metrics, (2) OTLP gateway exporter logs, (3) promtail/loki failures? Need dashboard urls + kubectl commands. Thanks :pray:

maria: @alex start with the grafana "Private: Prometheus Remote Write" dashboard -> panel "remote_write queue length" + "remote_write errors". link: https://grafana.redwood-internal.com/d/privvpc/custx-prom-remotewrite?orgId=1

maria: check these metrics via prom query:
```
http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/query?query=prometheus_remote_storage_queued_samples_total
http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/query?query=prometheus_remote_storage_queue_length
```

maria: and inspect OTLP pod logs:
```
kubectl -n obs get pods -l app=otlp-gateway
kubectl -n obs logs <pod> --since=1h | grep -i backoff
```

jamie: also check envoy metrics if remote_write goes through proxy: `envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_5xx` and `envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_time`. If you see long tails, it's backpressure. For prom cache evictions look at `prometheus_tsdb_head_series` and `prometheus_tsdb_head_series_created_total` to see churn.

sourav: runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/OBS/Private+VPC+Remote+Write+Runbook — has checklist + escalation. If you need, flip prom client to debug for 15m to capture retries (watch log volume).

alex: thanks — I'll grab logs and attach here. starting with otlp-gateway logs and prom query results. pinging if I need a hand :thumbsup:
